title: Account Clusterer & Impact-First Scoper — CS intake accelerator
text:
Account Clusterer & Impact-First Scoper — CS intake accelerator

description:
Create a concise, repeatable runbook and lightweight tooling to aggregate Sales/CS enterprise feature requests into account clusters, produce an 'impact-first' initial scoping artifact (fast-scope), and hand off prioritized candidates to PM/Eng for feasibility review. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-decision for high-touch asks from days to under 48 hours and to standardize signal capture so follow-ups and costing are consistent.

acceptance_criteria:
Runbook document (<=2 pages) that CS can follow to produce a fast-scope packet per account cluster
Fast-scope template populated for at least 8 pilot accounts with consistent fields: problem statement, usage signal, 3-tier solution options, estimated rough engineering effort (S/M/L), expected unit-cost delta, and customer-priority score
Automated CSV export from the intake sheet that groups requests by account tags and keywords (prototype script)
At least one engineering feasibility note (ENG-4321) attached per top-3 prioritized packets
Stakeholder sign-off from Sales lead and two PMs on the pilot outputs

implementation_notes:
Cluster heuristics: primary key = account_id, secondary = problem_family tag (billing|security|model-routing|observability), tertiary = urgency_label set by CS
Scoring rubric fields: customer_priority (1-5), business_impact_est ($/mo or qualitative), engineering_risk (low/med/high), cost_band (S/M/L), recommended_route (hosted/dedicated/private), ROI_one_liner
Fast-scope packet outputs: one-page summary, 3-option solution table, rough cost delta band, recommended next step (prototype / design spike / RFC)
Prototype exports to CSV/Drive and posts a summary message to #pm-sales-intake Slack with link to packet
When engineering_risk == high, auto-add ENG-4321 as dependency and flag for deep sample runs (Option B)

comments:
2025-02-25 — Aisha Patel: Kickoff. Observed repeated ask patterns from three strategic accounts (billing routing priority, private model pinning, and audit log retention). Current CS flow creates one ticket per request which fragments decisioning. Proposal: cluster by account+problem family, run quick RICE-like scoring, and synthesize a single packet for PM review.
2025-02-27 — Liam O'Connor: Draft runbook added to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/spaces/PM/pages/Account+Clusterer+Runbook (first-pass). Key sections: input signals, mandatory fields, clustering heuristics, scoring rubric, handoff checklist.
2025-03-01 — Eng (Priya Sharma): Engineering review. Positive on concept; flagged a backend constraint: determining 'estimated unit-cost delta' requires sampling token mix from customer logs and running against quantized model variants — depends on ENG-4321. Also suggested we include a 'fallback compatible model' column to accelerate serving options.
2025-03-02 — Sales (Marco Ruiz): Piloting with five accounts this week. Provided sample CSV exports and annotated asks. Request: include a short ROI field for execs (one-line: "estimated monthly savings or revenue opportunity"). Added to template.
2025-03-03 — PM sync (Aisha/Liam/Claire): Trade-offs discussed. Option A = fast packet with approximate cost bands (low friction, faster decisions). Option B = deeper sampler + perf run (more accurate but 5–7 days). Decided pilot will use Option A for first-pass and escalate top candidates to Option B when engineering indicates medium/high feasibility risk.
2025-03-04 — Design (Ellen Park): Reviewed packet layout. Suggested two visual changes: (1) one-line summary card at top (problem / ask / impact) and (2) a small 3-column solution options table (low-effort / medium / high). Will provide mockup by 2025-03-06.
2025-03-05 — Liam O'Connor: Prototype script (intake-cluster.py) committed to shared drive and linked to runbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tools/pull/12345. Script groups CSV rows by account+keyword heuristics and outputs the fast-scope template prefilled for review. Note: needs a small token-sample accessor that relies on ENG-4321 — marked as dependency.
2025-03-05 — Next steps (Liam): 1) Run pilot on 8 accounts and collect feedback (owner: Marco), 2) add ROI one-liner to template (owner: Aisha), 3) engineering to produce cost-band quick lookup (owner: Priya / ENG-4321), 4) design to publish mockup (owner: Ellen). Target decision checkpoint: 2025-03-11 PM sync.
